title: Caltex Australia Limited - proposed acquisition of the retail assets of Mobil Oil Australia Pty Ltd

timeline.event: Caltex announced that it had entered into an agreement to acquire 302 Mobil service station sites located in metropolitan areas in South Australia and along the east coast of Australia.
ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties, consumers and market participants.
ACCC requested further information from Caltex. ACCC timeline suspended.
Caltex responded to the ACCC's information requested of 10 July 2009. ACCC timeline recommenced.

ACCC published a Statement of Issues outlining preliminary competition concerns. Former proposed date for announcement of ACCC's findings deferred to allow for submissions relating to Statement of Issues.
Closing date for submissions relating to Statement of Issues.

Former proposed date for announcement of ACCC's findings of 7 October 2009 deferred in response to a request by Caltex to allow it additional time to provide further information to the ACCC. ACCC timeline suspended pending receipt of this information.
Further information provided by Caltex. ACCC timeline recommenced.

Former proposed date for announcement of ACCC's findings of 11 November 2009, amended in response to a request by Caltex to allow it additional time to provide further information to the ACCC and to allow the ACCC to consider the information.
ACCC announced that it would oppose the proposed acquisition.
